definition: Facts or information that show whether something is true.
example: The report offers little evidence that the new policy has reduced traffic.

fr.definition: Faits ou informations qui montrent si quelque chose est vrai.

de.definition: Fakten oder Informationen, die zeigen, ob etwas wahr ist.

es.definition: Hechos o información que muestran si algo es cierto.

pt.definition: Dados ou informações que mostram se algo é verdadeiro.

definition: To give only the main points of something.
example: Please summarize the article in three sentences before the seminar.

fr.definition: Présenter seulement les points principaux de quelque chose.

de.definition: Nur die wichtigsten Punkte von etwas wiedergeben.

es.definition: Presentar solo los puntos principales de algo.

pt.definition: Apresentar apenas os pontos principais de algo.

definition: To have a different opinion from someone else.
example: I disagree with you about the cost, but I like the idea itself.

fr.definition: Avoir une opinion différente de celle de quelqu'un.

de.definition: Eine andere Meinung als jemand anderes haben.

es.definition: Tener una opinión diferente de la de otra persona.

pt.definition: Ter uma opinião diferente da de outra pessoa.

definition: To say or do something that helps people relax when they first meet.
example: Our teacher told a funny story to break the ice on the first day.

fr.definition: Dire ou faire quelque chose pour détendre l'atmosphère lors d'une première rencontre.

de.definition: Etwas sagen oder tun, damit sich Menschen beim ersten Treffen entspannen.

es.definition: Decir o hacer algo para que la gente se relaje al conocerse.

pt.definition: Dizer ou fazer algo para que as pessoas se descontraiam ao conhecer-se.

definition: Large or important enough to have an effect or to be noticed.
example: There was a significant rise in applications after the fees were cut.

fr.definition: Assez important pour avoir un effet ou être remarqué.

de.definition: Groß oder wichtig genug, um eine Wirkung zu haben oder bemerkt zu werden.

es.definition: Lo bastante grande o importante como para tener efecto o notarse.

pt.definition: Suficientemente grande ou importante para ter efeito ou ser notado.

definition: An argument that opposes another argument.
example: She predicted the main counterargument and answered it before anyone raised it.

fr.definition: Argument qui s'oppose à un autre argument.

de.definition: Ein Argument, das einem anderen Argument widerspricht.

es.definition: Argumento que se opone a otro argumento.

pt.definition: Argumento que se opõe a outro argumento.

definition: To admit, often unwillingly, that something is true.
example: He conceded that the plan was expensive but insisted it was worth it.

fr.definition: Admettre, souvent à contrecœur, que quelque chose est vrai.

de.definition: Zugeben, oft widerwillig, dass etwas wahr ist.

es.definition: Admitir, a menudo a regañadientes, que algo es cierto.

pt.definition: Admitir, muitas vezes a contragosto, que algo é verdade.

definition: Something that has both good and bad effects.
example: Early fame can be a double-edged sword for young athletes.

fr.definition: Quelque chose qui a des effets à la fois positifs et négatifs.

de.definition: Etwas, das sowohl gute als auch schlechte Folgen hat.

es.definition: Algo que tiene efectos buenos y malos a la vez.

pt.definition: Algo que tem efeitos bons e maus ao mesmo tempo.

definition: Showing an awareness of subtle differences in meaning or opinion.
example: The essay offers a nuanced reading of the poet's early work.

fr.definition: Qui tient compte de différences subtiles.

es.definition: Que tiene en cuenta diferencias sutiles.

pt.definition: Que tem em conta diferenças subtis.

definition: To confirm or support a statement or theory with new evidence.
example: Two independent studies corroborate the original findings.

fr.definition: Confirmer ou appuyer une affirmation par de nouvelles preuves.

de.definition: Eine Aussage oder Theorie durch neue Belege bestätigen.

es.definition: Confirmar o respaldar una afirmación con nuevas pruebas.

pt.definition: Confirmar ou apoiar uma afirmação com novas provas.

definition: Not able to be defended against criticism or attack.
example: Once the data was published, the minister's position became untenable.

fr.definition: Qui ne peut pas être défendu face aux critiques.

es.definition: Que no se puede defender frente a las críticas.

pt.definition: Que não pode ser defendido contra críticas.

definition: To argue against an idea, even if you agree with it, in order to test it.
example: Let me play devil's advocate: what if the cheaper option is actually better?

fr.definition: Défendre la position contraire, même sans y croire, pour tester une idée.

de.definition: Eine Gegenposition vertreten, auch ohne sie zu teilen, um eine Idee zu prüfen.

es.definition: Defender la postura contraria, aunque no se comparta, para poner a prueba una idea.

pt.definition: Defender a posição contrária, mesmo sem concordar, para testar uma ideia.

definition: Relating to knowledge and to how we come to know things.
example: The paper raises epistemic questions about what counts as reliable data.

fr.definition: Relatif à la connaissance et à la manière dont on sait les choses.

de.definition: Die Erkenntnis und die Art, wie wir etwas wissen, betreffend.

es.definition: Relativo al conocimiento y a cómo sabemos las cosas.

pt.definition: Relativo ao conhecimento e à forma como sabemos as coisas.

definition: Seeming reasonable at first, but actually wrong.
example: His specious reasoning fell apart under cross-examination.

fr.definition: Qui semble juste au premier abord mais qui est en réalité faux.

de.definition: Auf den ersten Blick einleuchtend, aber eigentlich falsch.

es.definition: Que parece razonable a primera vista pero en realidad es falso.

pt.definition: Que parece razoável à primeira vista, mas na verdade é falso.

definition: A win that costs the winner so much that it is hardly worth it.
example: The lawsuit was a Pyrrhic victory: they won the case but lost their biggest client.

fr.definition: Victoire obtenue à un prix si élevé qu'elle ne vaut presque rien.

de.definition: Ein Sieg, der so teuer erkauft ist, dass er kaum etwas wert ist.

es.definition: Victoria que cuesta tanto que apenas vale la pena.

pt.definition: Vitória que custa tanto que quase não compensa.
